sections.title: Useful Patterns
sections.subtitle: Food preferences, polite ordering, and restaurant requests

items.usage: Use like/love/prefer to describe the food you enjoy.
examples: I really like Asian cuisine, especially spicy dishes.
I love Thai food because the flavors are amazing.
I prefer something healthy, like grilled chicken and vegetables.

items.usage: Use taste + adjective, or this dish is + adjective.
examples: This dish is fresh and delicious.

items.usage: Use recommend + noun, or you should try + food.
Use I'd like or Could I have instead of direct I want.
examples: I'd like a combo meal, please.
Could I have a glass of water?

items.usage: Use Excuse me or I'm afraid before describing the problem.
examples: Excuse me, this dish is a bit cold.
I'm afraid this is too salty.

sections.title: Speaking Questions
sections.subtitle: Answer first, then upgrade your answer with a reason

items.question: What is your favorite food?
answers: My favorite food is beef noodle soup.
It tastes savory and a little spicy, and I like it because it is warm and filling.

items.question: Do you prefer spicy or sweet food? Why?
answers: I prefer spicy food because it has a stronger flavor.
I like sweet food sometimes, but I try not to eat too many desserts.

items.question: What do you usually order at a restaurant?
answers: I usually order sushi or sashimi at a Japanese restaurant.
If I want something simple, I order a combo meal with a drink.

items.question: How often do you eat fast food?
answers: I eat fast food once or twice a month.
I think it is convenient, but I try to eat it in moderation.

items.question: Have you ever had a bad experience in a restaurant?
answers: Yes, once my dish was cold, so I said, "Excuse me, this dish is a bit cold."

paragraphs.text: Eating healthy food is important for our bodies and minds. Junk food like burgers, fries, and sugary drinks may taste good, but it is not very healthy.
A healthy diet includes vegetables, fruits, whole grains, and protein like fish or chicken. These foods give us energy and help us stay strong.
Some people have special diets. Vegetarians do not eat meat, and others may avoid certain ingredients because of allergies.
Fast food is popular because it is quick, affordable, and easy to find. It is convenient for busy people, but it is often high in fat, sugar, and salt.
Some fast food chains now offer healthier options, such as salads, fruit, and low-calorie meals. It is important to make balanced choices and eat fast food in moderation.

comprehension.question: Why is healthy eating important?
comprehension.answer: It is important for our bodies and minds, and it helps us have energy.

comprehension.question: What foods are part of a healthy diet?
comprehension.answer: Vegetables, fruits, whole grains, and protein are part of a healthy diet.

comprehension.question: Why do people choose fast food?
comprehension.answer: People choose fast food because it is quick, affordable, convenient, and easy to find.

comprehension.question: What are the disadvantages of fast food?
comprehension.answer: It is often high in fat, sugar, and salt, so it can cause health problems if eaten too often.

comprehension.question: How can people eat fast food in a healthier way?
comprehension.answer: They can choose healthier options, make balanced choices, and eat fast food in moderation.
